Built **LOWLIFE**, a standalone, mobile-friendly city hustle game in `index.html`.

It includes multiple screens for your neighborhood, market, network, assets, and life ledger. You can build reputation, negotiate with fictional suppliers, manage inventory, meet customers, take side hustles, lay low, and buy properties and cars. Progress and game state save locally in your browser.

**Assumptions:** The setting and goods are fictional. Crew and trusted contacts represent protection; weapons and real-world illegal trade details are not included. Police influence is represented as fictional city favors.

**Verified:** Core navigation, buying and selling, supplier negotiation, local saves, mobile layout at 390×844, and a clean browser console.
